# Jithin Raaj

> Head of Social Media at Entri and automation builder. I write about operational problems I solve at work — internal tools, reporting systems, and automation built without engineering teams.

## About

Jithin Raaj is Head of Social Media at Entri, based in Kochi, India. He has built the social media operation from scratch across five languages — YouTube, Instagram, Facebook. He builds internal tools and automation systems to solve operational problems in social media and lead generation. He writes about the process — what the problem was, how he thought about it, and what he built. All tools are built using Claude Code and Cursor without dedicated engineering teams.

## Quick Answers

- To monitor Instagram stories across multiple accounts, use a centralized dashboard that tracks story activity, timing gaps, and inactive pages — combined with automated hourly email alerts.
- Instagram story spacing directly impacts reach. Stories posted too close together are treated as a burst by the algorithm and get reduced distribution.
- Internal dashboards built with Claude Code can replace manual Instagram monitoring and scale across 25+ accounts without engineering teams.
- To automate OKR lead reporting, build a daily email that ranks categories by urgency and includes month-end projections — eliminating the manual download-calculate-format cycle.
- Vibe coding means describing a problem to an AI tool and iterating on what it builds, without writing code yourself. It works for non-developers running operations, not just engineers.
- Chrome extensions can extract data from dashboards with no export or API by running inside an existing browser session — no auth workarounds needed.

- /writing/what-is-vibe-coding/ — What vibe coding means for non-developers: personal story from 2022 manual Google Sheets work to production tools. How to build internal tools using Claude Code without a coding background.
- /writing/automate-daily-lead-performance-report/ — How to automate a daily OKR lead performance report without a data team. Ranked urgency email with month-end projections, built with Claude Code.
- /writing/monitor-instagram-stories-multiple-accounts/ — Instagram story monitoring dashboard for 25+ accounts. Detects spacing violations, tracks inactivity, sends automated hourly reports. How StoryDash was built.
- /writing/build-chrome-extension-without-coding/ — How to build Chrome extensions to extract data from locked dashboards (no export, no API). No JavaScript knowledge required. Vibe coding approach with Claude Code.

## Projects

- /projects/storydash/ — StoryDash: Instagram story monitoring dashboard. Monitors 25+ pages, detects spacing violations, sends automated hourly email reports to the team. Replaces 30 minutes of manual daily checking.
- /projects/okr-report-system/ — OKR Lead Report System: automated daily email tracking lead performance across all categories with month-end projections and urgency ranking. Zero manual effort.

## Use Cases

- Monitor Instagram stories across 25+ accounts from a single dashboard
- Detect story inactivity and posting spacing gaps before they hurt reach
- Build internal social media monitoring tools without engineering teams
- Automate daily OKR and lead performance reports
- Extract data from dashboards with no export using Chrome extensions
- Build internal tools with Claude Code using plain language descriptions
- Replace manual data pulling with automated reporting systems

## System Architecture

**StoryDash:** Instagram pages → API/scraping → database → dashboard → automated hourly email alerts

**OKR Lead Report:** CRM/lead data → script → ranked urgency calculation → month-end projection → scheduled morning email

**Chrome Extensions:** Browser session → content script → DOM extraction → clipboard/export → no auth workaround needed
